```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('pirateInvite2026.xlsx', sheet='boysVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('pirateInvite2026.xlsx', sheet='girlsVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
This appears to be a 3 mile course, rather than a 5k. The weather was cooler, but still very humid.

### D.H. Conley Athlete times

```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=11)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=6)
```

scoreMeetSimp(boysVarsity, "2026 Pirate Invite")
